tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: $kitBg: the window's ground, under toolbars, sidebars and panels. Carries fg, muted, faint, accent-text and the tones as text.

tokens.name: side
tokens.usage: $kitSide: a sidebar, the toolbar and the statusbar. Carries fg, muted, faint and the tones as text.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: $kitPanel: a panel's body, a table, a waterfall, the quiet fill of a bordered control (Ledger, Phosphor) and an empty checkbox. The ground every text role is checked against first.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: $kitRaised: a float above the window: a dialog, a popover, a menu, a toast, a chart's readout, a log's Latest button, Neutral's switch knob.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: $kitSunken: a well cut into a surface: a text area, a code block, a log, a notice, a badge, a skeleton, Neutral's field box and quiet button fill, an off switch track.

tokens.name: hover
tokens.usage: $kitHover: the translucent wash over a hovered row, tab, menu item, ghost button or split handle; striped table rows. Text on it stays fg.

tokens.name: press
tokens.usage: $kitPress: the wash under a pressed ghost control, a segmented control's track and a table or list pill. Every text role reads on it laid over a surface.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: $kitRule: a hairline between rows, under a header, a toolbar or a tab strip; a split's line; chart grid lines; Neutral's region frame and field edge. Decoration, not a boundary that carries meaning: about 1.3 to 1.5:1 on panel.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: $kitInk: the region rule and the control border where controls are outlined (Ledger 2px, Phosphor 1px), a float's edge, Ledger's switch knob, the hard shadow's colour, a focused underline. In Neutral it is a soft grey: its float edge and empty checkbox border sit at 1.65:1 on panel, kept as Kit draws them.

tokens.name: fg
tokens.usage: $kitFg: body text and labels. Reads at 4.5:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, on the hover and press washes over each, on a segment's hover and press over its track, and on every hover and press shade of panel, sunken and raised.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: $kitMuted: secondary text: subtitles, hints, field and stat labels, unsorted table headers, a list's detail line, a segment's count, a chevron, a dismiss ×. 4.5:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, on the hover and press washes over each, and on a segment's hover and press over its track.

tokens.name: faint
tokens.usage: $kitFaint: the quietest text: counts, times, shortcuts, chart ticks and y labels, line numbers, a log's times, a placeholder; the resting underline under a field (3:1 or more as an edge). 4.5:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken and on the hover and press washes over each.

tokens.name: sel
tokens.usage: $kitSel: a selected row in a table, list or menu, a pressed toggle button, a selected waterfall span. Ledger's selection is its yellow; Neutral's is a translucent blue over the panel.

tokens.name: sel-fg
tokens.usage: $kitSelFg: text on sel (over panel where sel is translucent). 4.5:1 or more on sel in every theme.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: $kitAccent: the one loud colour: the primary button, a ticked box, an on switch track, the chosen tab's underline, a slider and progress fill, bars, the sparkline's default line, an accent badge. As a fill it carries on-accent. Ledger's yellow is a fill, not a mark: as a line or bar on Ledger light's panel it is 1.41:1, kept as Kit draws it.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: $kitOnAccent: text and the check mark on an accent fill: the primary button's label, an accent badge, a ticked box. 4.5:1 or more on accent in every theme; see accent-hover for its shades.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: $kitFocus: the keyboard focus ring (2px, 2px outside the control) and Kit's info tone: an info notice, toast bar and badge. Moved in lightness by Kit until it reads at 4.5:1 on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: $kitOk: success: an ok badge, notice, toast and stat delta, a success button's label and edge. 4.5:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken and on the hover and press washes over each.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: $kitWarn: warning: a warn badge, notice, toast, stat delta and log level. 4.5:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken and on the hover and press washes over each.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: $kitDanger: errors and destruction: the danger button's fill, a field in error, a danger notice, badge, toast and log level, an alert count. As text, 4.5:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken and on the hover and press washes over each; as a fill it carries on-danger.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: $kitOnDanger: the label on a danger fill: the page's colour where danger is dark, the ink where it is light. 4.5:1 or more on danger; see danger-hover for its shades.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: $kitScrim: what a dialog dims the window with, translucent over everything under it.

tokens.name: group-1
tokens.usage: $kitGroup1: a waterfall span's fill, group 1: 3:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, in a lightness tier of its own beside its neighbours; its label in group-fg-1.

tokens.name: group-2
tokens.usage: $kitGroup2: a waterfall span's fill, group 2: 3:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, in a lightness tier of its own beside its neighbours; its label in group-fg-2.

tokens.name: group-3
tokens.usage: $kitGroup3: a waterfall span's fill, group 3: 3:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, in a lightness tier of its own beside its neighbours; its label in group-fg-3.

tokens.name: group-4
tokens.usage: $kitGroup4: a waterfall span's fill, group 4: 3:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, in a lightness tier of its own beside its neighbours; its label in group-fg-4.

tokens.name: group-5
tokens.usage: $kitGroup5: a waterfall span's fill, group 5: 3:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, in a lightness tier of its own beside its neighbours; its label in group-fg-5.

tokens.name: group-6
tokens.usage: $kitGroup6: a waterfall span's fill, group 6: 3:1 or more on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken, in a lightness tier of its own beside its neighbours; its label in group-fg-6.

tokens.name: group-fg-1
tokens.usage: $kitGroupFg1: a waterfall span's label on group-1: whichever of fg, bg, black and white reads best on it, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: group-fg-2
tokens.usage: $kitGroupFg2: a waterfall span's label on group-2: whichever of fg, bg, black and white reads best on it, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: group-fg-3
tokens.usage: $kitGroupFg3: a waterfall span's label on group-3: whichever of fg, bg, black and white reads best on it, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: group-fg-4
tokens.usage: $kitGroupFg4: a waterfall span's label on group-4: whichever of fg, bg, black and white reads best on it, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: group-fg-5
tokens.usage: $kitGroupFg5: a waterfall span's label on group-5: whichever of fg, bg, black and white reads best on it, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: group-fg-6
tokens.usage: $kitGroupFg6: a waterfall span's label on group-6: whichever of fg, bg, black and white reads best on it, 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: $kitSeries1: a chart's first series line (1.5px) and its legend swatch. A mark, 3:1 or more on panel.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: $kitSeries2: a chart's second series, and ANSI blue in a log line. A mark, 3:1 or more on panel.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: $kitSeries3: a chart's third series. A mark, 3:1 or more on panel.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: $kitSeries4: a chart's fourth series. A mark, 3:1 or more on panel.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: $kitSeries5: a chart's fifth series, and ANSI magenta in a log line. A mark, 3:1 or more on panel except Neutral light (2.36:1), kept as Kit draws it.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: $kitSeries6: a chart's sixth series, and ANSI cyan in a log line. A mark, 3:1 or more on panel.

tokens.name: area-1
tokens.usage: $kitArea1: the area under the first line of a line chart with area: series-1 at Kit's 0.14 alpha.

tokens.name: area-2
tokens.usage: $kitArea2: series-2 at 0.14 alpha (Kit fills the area under the first series only).

tokens.name: area-3
tokens.usage: $kitArea3: series-3 at 0.14 alpha (Kit fills the area under the first series only).

tokens.name: area-4
tokens.usage: $kitArea4: series-4 at 0.14 alpha (Kit fills the area under the first series only).

tokens.name: area-5
tokens.usage: $kitArea5: series-5 at 0.14 alpha (Kit fills the area under the first series only).

tokens.name: area-6
tokens.usage: $kitArea6: series-6 at 0.14 alpha (Kit fills the area under the first series only).

tokens.name: chosen
tokens.usage: $kitChosen: a segmented control's chosen segment: printed in the ink where controls are outlined (Ledger, Phosphor), a raised chip in Neutral.

tokens.name: chosen-fg
tokens.usage: $kitChosenFg: the label on chosen. 4.5:1 or more on chosen in every theme.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: $kitAccentText: the accent as text: an accent notice, an accent toast's bar and icon. Kit moves the accent in lightness until it reads at 4.5:1 on bg, side, panel, raised and sunken (Ledger light's yellow becomes an olive).

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: $kitAccentHover: the primary button under the pointer, opaque: accent moved 16% toward on-accent. on-accent on it is 3.49:1 in Neutral light and 3.68:1 in Phosphor light, kept as Kit draws it.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: $kitAccentPress: the primary button held, and a slider handle held: accent moved 30% toward on-accent. on-accent on it is 2.78:1 in Neutral light, 3.54:1 in Neutral dark and 2.89:1 in Phosphor light, kept as Kit draws it.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: $kitDangerHover: the danger button under the pointer: danger moved 16% toward on-danger. on-danger on it holds 4.5:1.

tokens.name: danger-press
tokens.usage: $kitDangerPress: the danger button held: danger moved 30% toward on-danger. on-danger on it falls to 3.5 to 3.9:1 in every theme, kept as Kit draws it.

tokens.name: panel-hover
tokens.usage: $kitPanelHover: a quiet bordered button (Ledger, Phosphor) under the pointer: hover laid opaque over panel. fg on it 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: panel-press
tokens.usage: $kitPanelPress: that button held: press over panel. fg on it 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: sunken-hover
tokens.usage: $kitSunkenHover: Neutral's quiet button under the pointer: hover over sunken. fg on it 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: sunken-press
tokens.usage: $kitSunkenPress: Neutral's quiet button held: press over sunken. fg on it 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: raised-hover
tokens.usage: $kitRaisedHover: a toast's action and a log's Latest button under the pointer: hover over raised. fg on it 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: raised-press
tokens.usage: $kitRaisedPress: those held: press over raised. fg on it 4.5:1 or more.

tokens.name: shimmer
tokens.usage: $kitShimmer: the light a skeleton's shimmer sweeps across sunken: the well lit 70% toward white in light, 12% toward fg in dark.

tokens.name: shimmer-clear
tokens.usage: $kitShimmerClear: shimmer with no alpha, the soft edges of the band.

fontSize.note: Kit's text size tokens ($kitSize, $kitSizeLabel, $kitSizeTitle) per skin, and the fixed sizes its charts and stats use. kui sets a line height of 1.35 times the size, rounded.

tokens.name: kit-size-ledger
tokens.usage: $kitSize in Ledger: body text, fields, menu items, list titles.

tokens.name: kit-size-label-ledger
tokens.usage: $kitSizeLabel in Ledger: labels on controls and headers, muted lines, counts, badges, log lines.

tokens.name: kit-size-title-ledger
tokens.usage: $kitSizeTitle in Ledger: a dialog's title, an empty state's title, a window's name in its toolbar.

tokens.name: kit-size-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitSize in Neutral.

tokens.name: kit-size-label-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitSizeLabel in Neutral.

tokens.name: kit-size-title-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitSizeTitle in Neutral.

tokens.name: kit-size-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitSize in Phosphor.

tokens.name: kit-size-label-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitSizeLabel in Phosphor.

tokens.name: kit-size-title-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitSizeTitle in Phosphor: no bigger than body; bold carries it.

tokens.name: size-stat
tokens.usage: A stat's number, bold, in the data face.

tokens.name: size-tick
tokens.usage: Chart axis labels, bar values and names, in the data face.

tokens.name: size-axis
tokens.usage: A waterfall's time axis.

tokens.name: size-span
tokens.usage: A waterfall span's label.

tokens.name: disabled-opacity
tokens.usage: $disabledOpacity, the core theme's: a disabled button, field, option, menu item or checklist item, drawn whole at half strength.

tokens.name: area-alpha
tokens.usage: skin.AREA_ALPHA: how opaque the area under a line chart's first series is (area-1).

radius.note: Square in Ledger and Phosphor, 6px in Neutral. Marks take their own: round radios always, pills and switches round only where the skin rounds.

tokens.name: kit-radius-ledger
tokens.usage: $kitRadius in Ledger: every control, region and float is square.

tokens.name: kit-radius-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitRadius in Neutral: controls, regions, floats, wells, menu items.

tokens.name: kit-radius-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitRadius in Phosphor: square.

tokens.name: radius-tick
tokens.usage: A checkbox's corner where the skin rounds (Neutral); 0 in Ledger and Phosphor.

tokens.name: radius-radio
tokens.usage: A radio: round in every skin (half its 14px).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: A badge or pill where the skin rounds (Neutral); square elsewhere.

tokens.name: radius-track
tokens.usage: A switch track where the skin rounds; its knob is 7.

tokens.name: radius-knob
tokens.usage: A switch knob where the skin rounds: a raised disc.

tokens.name: radius-handle
tokens.usage: A slider handle where the skin rounds; square elsewhere.

tokens.name: radius-rail
tokens.usage: A slider's fill and rail in every skin; a progress track where the skin rounds.

tokens.name: radius-dot
tokens.usage: A status dot: a disc in every skin.

shadow.note: Kit's shadow under the primary button and every float. Ledger's is hard: 3px down and right in the ink, no blur. Neutral's is soft: 4px down, 16px blur, black at 18%. Phosphor's is a glow: 8px of blur in the ink, no offset, on strong things only.

tokens.name: shadow
tokens.usage: The strong shadow (ctx.shadow with strong): the primary button, a dialog, a popover, a menu, a toast. Ledger's face never moves off its shadow's far edge.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: Ledger's primary button under the pointer: the face moves 1px up and left and the shadow grows to 4px, so its far edge stays put. Held, the face drops 3px onto the shadow's place and the shadow goes. The other skins' primary does not move: their value is shadow's.

tokens.name: shadow-quiet
tokens.usage: The shadow without strong: a select's open list. Phosphor glows on strong things only, so it has none.

spacing.note: Kit's length tokens ($kitRow, $kitCtl, $kitHair, $kitRuleW, $kitShadow, $kitShadowBlur), set per skin and density, and the paddings and gaps Kit's components are built with, exactly as the source writes them. Comfortable is the default density.

tokens.name: kit-row
tokens.usage: $kitRow, comfortable: a table row, a menu item, a select option, a radio row, a section's heading; a table header is kit-row + 4.

tokens.name: kit-row-compact
tokens.usage: $kitRow under density = compact.

tokens.name: kit-ctl
tokens.usage: $kitCtl, comfortable: every control's height (button, field, select, segmented, checkbox and switch rows, checklist items), an icon button's side, the tab strip.

tokens.name: kit-ctl-compact
tokens.usage: $kitCtl under density = compact.

tokens.name: kit-hair
tokens.usage: $kitHair in every skin: row hairlines, a header's rule, a field's resting underline, Neutral's field and float edges, a framed table's border, a menu's and readout's edge.

tokens.name: kit-rule-w-ledger
tokens.usage: $kitRuleW in Ledger: a region's frame, a control's border, the chosen tab's underline, a focused or failing underline.

tokens.name: kit-rule-w-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitRuleW in Neutral.

tokens.name: kit-rule-w-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitRuleW in Phosphor.

tokens.name: kit-shadow-ledger
tokens.usage: $kitShadow in Ledger: the hard shadow's offset, both axes.

tokens.name: kit-shadow-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitShadow in Neutral: the soft shadow's drop.

tokens.name: kit-shadow-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitShadow in Phosphor: no offset.

tokens.name: kit-shadow-blur-neutral
tokens.usage: $kitShadowBlur in Neutral (Ledger's is 0).

tokens.name: kit-shadow-blur-phosphor
tokens.usage: $kitShadowBlur in Phosphor: the glow.

tokens.name: focus-ring-w
tokens.usage: The focus ring's width, in focus.

tokens.name: focus-ring-gap
tokens.usage: The gap between a control and its focus ring.

tokens.name: pad-page
tokens.usage: The Kit app's page padding and the gap between its cards.

tokens.name: pad-panel
tokens.usage: A panel's body padding (pad = 0 for a body that brings its own), a panel head's side padding, a popover's padding, a table cell's side padding, a waterfall's padding.

tokens.name: gap-panel
tokens.usage: The gap in a panel's body and head, a popover, a dialog body and foot, between a field and its Choose… button.

tokens.name: pad-ctl
tokens.usage: A button's and a segment's side padding, a tab's side padding.

tokens.name: pad-select
tokens.usage: A select's side padding; a Neutral field box's side padding; a menu item's side padding; a text area's padding.

tokens.name: pad-underline
tokens.usage: An underlined field's side padding (Ledger, Phosphor); a checklist item's.

tokens.name: gap-ctl
tokens.usage: Icon to label in a button, a section heading, a tab; between toolbar controls and a search's glass and query.

tokens.name: toolbar-h
tokens.usage: A toolbar's least height; its padding is 8 by 6.

tokens.name: statusbar-h
tokens.usage: A statusbar's height; its padding is 10 sideways, its gap 14.

tokens.name: gap-status
tokens.usage: The gap between items in a statusbar.

tokens.name: dialog-w
tokens.usage: A dialog's width when left out; its title row is 40 tall with 16 at the sides, its body 16 by 4, its foot 12.

tokens.name: dialog-head
tokens.usage: A dialog's title row.

tokens.name: pad-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog's side padding.

tokens.name: menu-w
tokens.usage: A menu's least width (a select's list: 160); its padding is 4, its rows 1 apart.

tokens.name: pad-menu
tokens.usage: A menu's and an open select's padding.

tokens.name: toast-w
tokens.usage: A toast's least width; it stops at 480. It floats 16 in from the window's corner.

tokens.name: toast-w-max
tokens.usage: A toast's widest.

tokens.name: toast-bar
tokens.usage: The tone bar down a toast's leading edge.

tokens.name: pad-notice-x
tokens.usage: A notice's side padding (8 top and bottom, 10 between icon, message and actions).

tokens.name: pad-notice-y
tokens.usage: A notice's top and bottom padding; a code block's padding.

tokens.name: pad-empty
tokens.usage: An empty state's padding; its lines are 6 apart.

tokens.name: indent-section
tokens.usage: A section body's left inset, under its title.

tokens.name: split-handle
tokens.usage: The strip a split's rule is grabbed by.

tokens.name: key-w
tokens.usage: An inspector's key column when left out.

tokens.name: badge-h
tokens.usage: A badge's and a pill's height; padding 6 sideways, 5 between dot and label.

tokens.name: mark
tokens.usage: A checkbox's and a radio's square, a switch knob, an icon in a toast or notice.

tokens.name: switch-w
tokens.usage: A switch track's width (18 tall, 2 padding).

tokens.name: switch-h
tokens.usage: A switch track's height; a slider's track box.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: A badge's status dot, a radio's dot, a sparkline's readout dot.

tokens.name: rail
tokens.usage: A progress track's and a slider rail's thickness.

tokens.name: handle
tokens.usage: A slider handle's side.

tokens.name: lane-h
tokens.usage: A waterfall lane; its spans are 16 tall, 2 apart.

tokens.name: line-code
tokens.usage: A code block's line height.

tokens.name: line-area
tokens.usage: A text area's line height; rows × 17 + 16 is its least height.

families.data: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace
families.neutral-data: "JetBrains Mono", "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
families.phosphor: "IBM Plex Mono", "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace
families.ui: "Space Grotesk", "IBM Plex Sans", system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

groups.name: Ledger
groups.note: Kit's default skin. $kitUi is Space Grotesk, then IBM Plex Sans, then the system sans. Labels on controls and headers are bold capitals, written into the string.

styles.name: ledger-title
styles.usage: $kitSizeTitle, bold: a dialog's title, an empty state's title, the window's name in the toolbar.

styles.name: ledger-body
styles.sample: Three edits since the last save will be lost.
styles.usage: $kitSize: body text, field values, menu items, list titles, notice messages.

styles.name: ledger-label
styles.usage: $kitSizeLabel, bold, capitals: labels on buttons, tabs, segments and panel and table headers; a field's or stat's label in muted.

styles.name: ledger-muted
styles.sample: requests a second, by minutes ago
styles.usage: $kitSizeLabel, regular, as written, in muted: subtitles, hints, a progress label, a list row's detail.

groups.name: Neutral
groups.note: Inter and the system face; sentence case; labels regular, the primary button's aside.

styles.name: neutral-body
styles.sample: Dinner for six. Risotto + chard, cardamom buns for after.

styles.name: neutral-label
styles.usage: $kitSizeLabel in Neutral: control and header labels, regular and as written; the primary button's label is bold.

groups.name: Phosphor
groups.note: One mono face for everything: IBM Plex Mono, then JetBrains Mono.

styles.name: phosphor-body
styles.sample: All 4 instances are cycled one at a time.

styles.name: phosphor-label
styles.usage: $kitSizeLabel in Phosphor: bold capitals, as Ledger.

groups.name: Data
groups.note: $kitData: ids, timings, numbers, code, log lines. Ledger's is IBM Plex Mono; Neutral's JetBrains Mono (family neutral-data); Phosphor's is its one face.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: $kitSize in the data face: mono table columns, inspector values, a code block (line height 16).

styles.name: data-label
styles.usage: $kitSizeLabel in the data face: counts, shortcuts, log lines, a search count, a slider's value.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: A stat's number: 22px bold in the data face.

styles.name: tick
styles.usage: Chart axis labels, gutter labels, bar values: 10px in the data face, faint.
